I think growth hack #1 yields more control over the velocity each iteration could be executed upon since you don’t need to wait for a festival or a vending opportunity to happen before an iteration can be done 

However it might end up being more costly considering fuel cost and samples cost per iteration 

Growth hack #2 is more high leverage since you have more vendors aggregated in one spot 

Growth hack #3 which I spoke about with @⁨Kirsten Ritschel⁩ is to organize our _own cacao circle tasting event in our own venue_ and then send out invites for the chocolate makers to come attend these

It’s yields high leverage per iteration and less costly sample cost wise than growth hack #1 but we have less opportunity for a captive audience scenario compared to growth hack #2
